issues.description: The master has `cd "INSERT FOLDER PATH"`; its relative `do`, input and output paths need the runtime working directory set to the `codes` folder, with sibling `NP`, `Manual` and `Output` folders.
The archive contains a 700-row CUSIP identifier list but no named NP/Manual analysis inputs consumed by the supplied workflow; no analysis-only route is supported.
The frozen checklist omits several direct author-source reads, while generated handoffs depend on missing author-prepared inputs. Period, identifier, field and construction contracts are not closed.

The required `director_main.dta` depends on a manual main-employer decision; the workflow also needs a year-specific journalist-name mapping. The commented source block does not supply the resulting files.
The exact checked Stata adopath lacks `ivreghdfe`, `probit2`, `outreg2`, and `winsor2`; source calls require these commands. `ffind` itself is available.

The master declares Stata 17 while the checked runtime is Stata 18; no model or package syntax was executed, and the datasheet warns that REGHDFE updates can affect syntax and clustered standard errors.

steps: Resolve each separate NP/Manual file requirement in the scope; confirm expected identifiers, fields, units, date coverage, product version and author cleaning/linkage rules.

For candidate CRSP, Compustat, SDC, IBES, 13F and BoardEx products, confirm the exact source-to-author-DTA mapping and complete required period/population; do not treat one-row reads or catalog listings as coverage.

Obtain the prepared `director_main.dta` and `j_connectnames_year.dta` or confirm the authors' manual decision and mapping procedures, including the commented BoardEx employment branch.

For WSJ/FT/press-release and fraud/news inputs, confirm article selection, article-to-deal joins, text fields and journalist attributes; public SEC indexes and SRAF links are candidate components only.
If rebuilding text inputs, first identify the exact public Python script/version and article corpus/output fields; no external code payload has been retrieved.
validation: Use bounded metadata checks on exact received files to verify the documented fields and format, then reconcile all producer/consumer handoffs before separately authorized execution.
